description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to JSON Remote Procedure Call (JSONRPC) handling within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes interface definitions, class implementations for managing JSONRPC messages, versioning, registration, event subscription, and observer notification mechanisms.

classes.name: IDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for a dispatcher that can invoke JSONRPC messages and manage activation/deactivation.

classes.name: JSONRPC
classes.description: Implementation of the IDispatcher interface, managing JSONRPC message handling, versioning, registration, and event subscriptions.

classes.name: VersionInfo
classes.description: Represents version information for a specific interface, including name and version numbers.

classes.name: Registration
classes.description: JSON container for registration details, including event and callsign.

classes.name: JSONRPCSupportsEventStatus
classes.description: Derived class adding support for event status notifications and observer management.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Factory method to create a new JSONRPC message.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Returns the callsign associated with the handler.

methods.name: CreateHandler
methods.description: Creates a new handler with specified versions.

methods.name: GetHandler
methods.description: Retrieves a handler supporting a specific version.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a method with the handler.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a method from the handler.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Sends a response to an inbound JSONRPC message.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a JSONRPC message, routing it to the appropriate handler.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Determines the destination handler and type based on the method designator.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the JSONRPC handler with a given shell service.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the handler, closing all handlers and clearing the service reference.

methods.name: RegisterEventStatusListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for event status changes.

methods.name: UnregisterEventStatusListener
methods.description: Removes a listener for event status changes.

methods.name: NotifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies registered observers of an event status change.
